@graph.headline: Do movers pack for you? Full, partial and fragile-only packing, explained

acceptedAnswer.text: Movers can pack for you — it is a standard service at three levels: full, partial, and fragile-only. You never have to pack yourself unless you prefer to. At The Flat Rate Movers, the level you choose is scoped room by room and quoted inside the one flat rate in writing before move day.

mainEntity.name: Do movers pack for you, or do you have to pack yourself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. That is partial packing, and the kitchen is the most common single-room assignment because it holds the most breakables per shelf in the house. You name the rooms or item classes; the crew packs exactly those, labels them by room, and everything else in the home stays yours to pack.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire movers to pack only the kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: At many companies, yes — packing is commonly billed hourly, sometimes with a minimum number of hours to send a crew (1). At The Flat Rate Movers it is not: packing is scoped with the job and priced inside the one flat rate in writing. No hourly packing clock exists here.

mainEntity.name: Is packing charged by the hour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep the irreplaceables with you: jewelry, important documents, medication, cash, and anything you will need the first night. Movers cannot pack hazardous materials or perishables at any level (1, 2), so plan a separate route for paint, fuel, and propane.

mainEntity.name: What should I pack myself, even with full packing?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is genuinely harder to claim. Federal consumer guidance notes that a mover's liability can be reduced by improper packing of containers you pack yourself (2), and if the carton arrives undamaged, fault is difficult to establish (1). That is the practical argument for fragile-only packing: the breakables are packed by the crew whose work stands behind them.

mainEntity.name: If I pack a box myself and something breaks, who is responsible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Packing only is a bookable scope on our quote form — the crew packs the rooms you assign, and transport is yours to arrange separately. It is commonly used before a container load, a storage move-in, a freight shipment, or a self-managed long-distance move where you drive or ship the packed boxes yourself.
